title: Target Brings More Value and Delight to Thanksgiving with a $30 Meal for Six and Fresh Takes on Holiday Favorites
summary: Nearly 60 new food and beverage items at Target make it easy to discover new favorites alongside Thanksgiving staples Good & Gather turkey at 79 cents per pound and $30 Thanksgiving meal for six...
body_markdown:
- *Nearly 60 new food and beverage items at Target make it easy to discover new favorites alongside Thanksgiving staples*
- *Good & Gather turkey at 79 cents per pound and $30 Thanksgiving meal for six leaves more room for fresh twists*


MINNEAPOLIS


, Oct. 22, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **Target Corporation** (NYSE: TGT) today announced how it's helping busy families save on Thanksgiving while celebrating the traditions they love and discovering new favorites. A new YouGov survey1 finds seven in 10 Americans value Thanksgiving food traditions, yet nearly half of those celebrating plan to put their own twist on a classic recipe this year. With nearly 60 new and trending food and beverage items, a $30 Thanksgiving meal for six2 and fresh finds for the home, Target is making it easier, more affordable and more inspiring for guests to bring their personal take to the holiday table.


"Thanksgiving and Friendsgiving are such joyful moments for our guests, and Target is making it easy and budget-friendly for them to plan meals that include plenty of familiar favorites plus some of the latest food trends," said **John Conlin** , senior vice president of merchandising, food and beverage, Target. "From exciting new flavors, to elevated takes on classics and convenient shortcuts to make meal prep a breeze, we're helping busy families celebrate the season with the fresh finds and value they count on from Target."


**Fresh finds to make Thanksgiving your own** With an **expanded assortment of $5 sides, pies, appetizers and wine** and limited-time offers throughout November3, Target is making it easy and affordable for guests to bring their own twist to Thanksgiving and Friendsgiving traditions. Nearly a third of those who celebrate Thanksgiving say appetizers are just as important as the main meal, and just as many say they snack throughout the day leading up to it, according to the survey. Guests can explore options including:


- **Sides:** Good & Gather Mashed Sweet Potatoes and Parmesan Cheese Topped Roasted Vegetables.
- **Desserts:** Favorite Day pies in new sizes and flavors like Apple Caramel Crumb.
- **Appetizers:** More than 10 new Good & Gather frozen options, including Blueberry and Brie Cheese Sticks and Feta Cheese and Honey Cheese Bites.


Desserts and side dishes are where guests see the most room to put a personal spin on Thanksgiving. From sourdough stuffing and flavorful brines to easy-to-prepare takes on classic dishes, guests can find more new or exclusive options to elevate their meal, including:

- Kinder's[Butcher's Brine Kit](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4803906-1&h=310229435&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fp%2Fkinder-39-s-brine-kit-11-25oz%2F-%2FA-94879992%23lnk%3Dsametab&a=Butcher%27s+Brine+Kit) ,[Bone Broth Gravy](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4803906-1&h=131044165&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fp%2Fkinder-39-s-roasted-turkey-bone-broth-gravy-mix-1oz%2F-%2FA-91368382&a=Bone+Broth+Gravy) and[Homestyle Stuffing Mix](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4803906-1&h=28951180&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fp%2Fkinder-39-s-homestyle-brown-butter-and-herbs-stuffing-mix-6oz%2F-%2FA-94879993&a=Homestyle+Stuffing+Mix)

**A Thanksgiving meal for six for just $30**
With savings on Thanksgiving staples, guests have more flexibility to discover new flavors, elevate familiar favorites and bring their own take to the holiday table. Beginning in November, **Good & Gather frozen turkey returns at just 79 cents per pound** for the third consecutive year, wherever it's sold. Families can also serve a complete **Thanksgiving meal for six for $30** , maintaining last year's $5-per-person value.


**Target's Thanksgiving meal includes:**


- Butterball Premium Whole Young Turkey, up to 10 lb.
- [Good & Gather Russet Potatoes](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4803906-1&h=4291332817&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fp%2Frusset-potatoes-5lb-brand-may-vary%2F-%2FA-77775602&a=Good+%26+Gather+Russet+Potatoes) , 3 lb. bag

**Style and design for the whole gathering**
For guests looking to celebrate in style, Target makes it easy to set the table, decorate the home and get the whole family ready for Thanksgiving. Guests can explore more than 200 new Threshold kitchen items, seasonal tablescape accents starting at $5 and on-trend home decor, including faux-fur throws. Family apparel features cozy, style-forward options from fleece starting at $10 to $45 cashmere sweaters.


For more on Target's 2026 holiday plans, visit[corporate.target.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4803906-1&h=1344209889&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcorporate.target.com%2Fpress%2Frelease%2F2026%2F10%2Ftarget-makes-it-easier-for-guests-to-discover-stylish-holiday-gifts-they-can-t-wait-to-give&a=corporate.target.com) .


*1* *YouGov conducted an online survey among 1,070 U.S. adults, of whom 1,014 celebrate Thanksgiving. The figures have been weighted and are representative of all U.S. adults ages 18+. Fieldwork was undertaken from Oct. 5-6, 2026.* *2* *Prices are pre-tax. Prices valid Nov. 8, 2026, through Nov. 29, 2026. Offer not valid in Alaska or Hawaii.*
